title: How to Process Unused Inpatient Drug Return Credits
content:
ARTICLE: How to Process Unused Inpatient Drug Return Credits (KA-027)
SYSTEM: Pharmacy System
DEPARTMENT: Pharmacy
VERSION: 2.0
OVERVIEW: This comprehensive operating guide details how hospital personnel should interact with the Pharmacy System module to execute how to process unused inpatient drug return credits safely and reliably.
STEPS:
Step 1: Open the Pharmacy System client terminal on any networked SMCH workstation and log in with role credentials.
Step 2: Enter the patient's unique UHID or Case Number to load active records.
Step 3: Access the designated submenu corresponding to How to Process Unused Inpatient Drug Return Credits and verify current patient status.
Step 4: Input all required clinical or administrative parameters, ensuring mandatory fields are validated.
Step 5: Verify preview confirmation modal and click 'Submit' to persist changes to the database.
Step 6: Print barcode, acknowledgement chit, or receipt as required by hospital compliance.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Connection timeout: Verify LAN cable connection or contact IT Helpdesk.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Permission Denied: Ensure user account has the assigned role in staff master permissions.
Contact Pharmacy coordinator or IT Operations Support at Extension 1033 (Email: it@smch.in).
